_about: Public-domain Samuel Minton (1820-1894), evangelical Anglican minister of Eaton Chapel, London, for the Word Hoard: The Glory of Christ in the Creation and Reconciliation of All Things (1871), his sermons on the Lord's Supper and the confessional, and his single sermons (1850-1877). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 92 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
